title: Excess tuition payments and credit-balance refunds
content: UTA issues refunds when payments or credits leave a credit balance after eligible charges are covered. An extra tuition payment does not by itself establish the final refundable amount. UTA recommends direct deposit for registration-charge refunds.
steps: Check whether your student account shows a credit balance; contact Student Accounts if the amount is unclear.

title: Checking refund status and contacting Student Accounts
content: Check refund status in MyMav by opening Accounts and choosing Refund in the left sidebar. UTA sends an email after processing. Its FAQ lists an additional 2-3 business days for direct deposit or 3-5 for a mailed check after processing; these are not promised processing dates. Questions can be sent to studentaccounts@uta.edu.
steps: Sign in to MyMav, open Accounts, then select Refund.
If the status or credit balance is unclear, contact studentaccounts@uta.edu through your own email; do not share account identifiers in this chat.

title: Refund payment method, mailing address and holds
content: Where possible, UTA returns credit-card payment refunds to the same card. Keep your MyMav mailing address and direct-deposit bank details current. A refund hold caused by dropping classes normally releases four days after the latest drop activity without action from the student.
steps: Review the refund status and any holds in MyMav.
Check that the mailing address and any direct-deposit details in MyMav are current.

title: Flywire overpayment handling
content: UTA's payment page distinguishes Flywire overpayments: an excess of up to $500 is refunded to the student, while an excess above $500 is returned to the originating bank. This rule is specific to Flywire and should not be applied to a different payment method.
steps: If you paid through Flywire, compare your payment with the total charges in your account.
Ask Student Accounts to confirm how the Flywire overpayment rule applies to your payment.

title: Pay tuition and fees in MyMav and TouchNet
content: For online payments, UTA directs students through MyUTA/MyMav: open Accounts, choose Make a Payment, and use the TouchNet payment portal. In TouchNet, choose Make Payment and select the charges to pay. The payment page notes that a pop-up blocker may need to be disabled for the portal.
steps: Sign in through the official MyUTA/MyMav link and open Accounts, then Make a Payment.
In TouchNet, select Make Payment and the charges you intend to pay.
